bayts.text: He Who makes the difficult easy has made easy for me what I chose for myself, without journeying.
The Accursed turned toward others than me, turning his back, with what lasts on the back as a sore.
An Everlasting One Who favoured me with His remembrance has effaced the turning of hateful things toward me, and He is my Patron.
With Him I am well pleased, and He is well pleased with me, without hateful things and without illnesses.
He Who made the passage and the homelands good has repelled Satan toward a direction other than mine.
The Accursed fled toward a direction other than mine: the Helper drives him toward others than us.
My gift from God and the Prophet: my whole being has become clear, and the ropes of my tent have become clear.
The enabling grace of a Guide led by inspiration has already shown me what was obscure.
The mysteries appeared to me today through my Lord; He protected me from those who hated and were disappointed.
No wearier makes for my direction; from me my hateful things and toil have been effaced.
My happiness has been written without erasure, and my being the slave, the servant, has already been confirmed.
He Who makes the difficult easy has thankfully accepted for me what He chose for me, without journeying.
